description: Source code for PDCCH (Physical Downlink Control Channel) PDU translation in a 5G NR simulation or implementation, including functions to fill parameters and convert MAC to FAPI format.

classes.name: mac_pdcch_precoding_info
classes.description: Structure holding precoding information for PDCCH transmission.

methods.name: fill_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Fills BWP parameters into the PDCCH PDU builder based on configuration.

methods.name: calculate_coreset0_freq_res_bitmap
methods.description: Calculates frequency resource bitmap for CORESET0.

methods.name: fill_coreset_parameters
methods.description: Fills CORESET parameters into the PDCCH PDU builder.

methods.name: fill_precoding_and_beamforming
methods.description: Sets precoding and beamforming parameters in the DCI PDU builder.

methods.name: convert_pdcch_mac_to_fapi
methods.description: Converts MAC layer PDCCH information into FAPI format for transmission.
